collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager has never crossed the rope bridge and a friend calls from halfway: take the first step, or take the long way.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's a rope bridge across the gully on the way to the far gardens. It's perfectly safe; everyone uses it. (subject) has never crossed it. (subject.He/she) always goes the long way, down into the gully and up the other side. Today (friend) is crossing and stops halfway to look back. "Coming?"

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) takes one step onto the bridge. It sways. (subject.He/she) grips the ropes. Another step. Another. (friend) waits in the middle, not hurrying (subject.him/her). It takes a very long time. On the other side, (subject)'s legs are shaking. (subject.He/she) did it. (subject.He/she) takes the long way home anyway.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "I'll meet you there," says (subject), and goes down into the gully. It takes longer, and it's muddy, and there's a lovely little waterfall halfway down that nobody who crosses the bridge ever sees. (subject) arrives a while after (friend), muddy to the knees, and perfectly content.
